newsitem.title: UK: IPE gasoil ends firmer, catching up with Brent.
newsitem.headline: IPE gasoil ends firmer, catching up with Brent.

text.p: IPE August gas oil closed stronger on Tuesday having played catch-up to Monday's crude gains for much of the day.
August gas oil closed at $176.00, up $3.75 a tonne within a very tight range. The spread between the day's high and low was only $1.75 - $175.00 to $176.75.
Dealers said business had been fairly sparse.
September Brent was down nine cents at $19.37 a barrel at 1745 GMT in what many saw as a consolidating phase after Monday's late hike higher.
Fresh news about the re-emergence of Iraqi oil on world markets is needed to shift the market, traders said.
The U.N. expect Iraq's pricing formula for the second round of oil-for-food sales later on Tuesday. If there are no objections approval should take two days from receiving the formula, the U.N. said.
